layers.en_desc: Unified build and dependency governance. The Maven parent POM and BOM that keep all 36 repositories on one baseline.
layers.zh_desc: 统一构建与依赖治理。所有子项目的 Maven 父 POM 与 BOM 在这里定义，保证 36 个仓库的构建口径一致。

layers.en_desc: Framework-free Java capabilities: strings and collections, reflection, type conversion, events, logging abstraction, plus Java / Jakarta EE implementations.
layers.zh_desc: 不依赖任何框架的纯 Java 能力层：字符串与集合、反射、类型转换、事件、日志抽象、Java / Jakarta EE 实现。

layers.en_desc: Enhancements for Spring, Spring Boot and Spring Cloud — the most central layer of the ecosystem.
layers.zh_desc: 对 Spring、Spring Boot、Spring Cloud 的增强扩展，是整个生态最核心的一层。

layers.en_desc: Adapters for concrete infrastructure: service registries, data access, caching, RPC, resilience and gateways.
layers.zh_desc: 面向具体基础设施的适配层：注册中心、数据访问、缓存、RPC、容错、网关。

layers.en_desc: Capabilities that cut across every layer: observability, internationalisation, security, dynamic configuration and multi-active routing.
layers.zh_desc: 贯穿所有层的可观测性、国际化、安全、动态配置、单元化多活等能力。

en.tagline: The shared Maven parent POM for the whole ecosystem
en.summary: Supplies unified build settings and plugin configuration inherited by every Microsphere sub-project, including Microsphere Java and Microsphere Spring. Multi-TLS compilation, release signing, coverage and documentation generation are all centralised here, so each repository only carries business code.
features: A single POM builds against Java 8, 11, 17, 21 and 25.
Locks Compiler, Source and Flatten plugin versions so no repository drifts.
Six built-in profiles: publish, release, ci, test, coverage and docs, activated on demand.
The publish profile integrates the Central Publishing plugin for the new Maven Central portal.
modules: 3.16.0 — compilation across multiple Java TLS versions
documentation generation under the docs profile
en.note: Since 0.2.0 the publish profile is the recommended path: OSSRH reached end of life on 2025-06-30 and every namespace migrated to the Central Publisher Portal.

zh.tagline: Microsphere 全系项目的 Maven 父 POM
zh.summary: 提供统一的构建设置与插件配置，被 Microsphere Java、Microsphere Spring 等所有子项目继承。它把 Java 多 TLS 版本编译、发布签名、覆盖率、文档生成等能力收敛到一处，让各子仓库只关心业务代码。
features: 同一份 POM 覆盖 Java 8、11、17、21、25 五个 TLS 版本的构建。
统一锁定 Compiler、Source、Flatten 等默认插件版本，避免各仓库版本漂移。
内置 publish、release、ci、test、coverage、docs 六套 profile，按需激活。
publish profile 集成 Central Publishing 插件，对接 Maven Central 新发布门户。
modules: 3.16.0 — 编译，支持多 Java TLS 版本
1.7.3 — 扁平化 POM 以便发布
docs profile 下的文档生成
zh.note: 自 0.2.0 起推荐使用 publish profile：OSSRH 已于 2025-06-30 下线，命名空间全部迁移至 Central Publisher Portal。

en.tagline: A cross-project Maven bill of materials
en.summary: Declares the versions of every Microsphere module in one place. Import it once to align all dependency versions and avoid conflicts across modules.
features: No need to declare a version for each module after importing the BOM.
Kept in sync with each sub-project's own dependencies module.
Pairs with the microsphere-build parent POM for a single build and dependency baseline.
modules: Top-level BOM aggregating every sub-project version

zh.tagline: 跨项目的 Maven 物料清单
zh.summary: 集中声明 Microsphere 生态各模块的版本，使用者导入一次即可对齐全部依赖版本，避免多模块之间的版本冲突。
features: 导入 BOM 后无需为每个模块指定 `<version>`。
与各子项目的 dependencies 模块保持版本同步。
配合 microsphere-build 父 POM 使用，构建与依赖口径统一。
modules: 顶层 BOM，聚合各子项目版本

en.tagline: The foundation of the ecosystem: reusable Java components and utilities
en.summary: Microsphere Java Framework is the backbone of the Microsphere ecosystem. Built purely on standard Java APIs, it ships a complete set of reusable components covering strings, collections, reflection, type conversion, event dispatching, class loading and artifact detection, networking, I/O and concurrency — plus a compile-time annotation processor. Every other sub-project builds on top of it.
features: Null-safe helpers for strings, arrays, lists, sets, maps and deques.
Simplified access to fields, methods, constructors and generic type arguments.
An extensible Converter SPI with built-in converters for primitives, collections, Duration, InputStream and more.
A lightweight EventDispatcher with sequential (direct) and parallel execution modes.
Classpath scanning, JAR introspection and Maven/module artifact resolution, including runtime version detection from JAR manifests.
A custom URLStreamHandler and URL helpers, plus enhanced file, stream and charset utilities with a file-watch service.
Delegating executor wrappers and a custom ThreadFactory.
SPI-based property loading with annotation-driven metadata generation.
An annotation processor that generates metadata for @ConfigurationProperty.
Components for the Java Language Model API, plus helpers bridging the compiler and annotation-processing tool APIs.
Base classes and utilities for JUnit 5-based unit tests.
modules: Core utilities: strings, collections, reflection, I/O, concurrency, events, type conversion
Components and utilities for the Java Language Model API
Helpers for the Java compiler and JDK tool APIs
Models and utilities for JUnit 5-based testing
Parent POM with shared build configuration

zh.tagline: 整个生态的地基：可复用的 Java 组件与工具集
zh.summary: Microsphere Java Framework 是 Microsphere 生态的骨干基础库。它基于标准 Java API 提供字符串、集合、反射、类型转换、事件分发、类加载与制品探测、网络、I/O、并发等一整套可复用组件，并内置编译期注解处理器。所有其它子项目都构建在它之上。
features: 对字符串、数组、List、Set、Map、Deque 的空安全（null-safe）辅助方法。
简化字段、方法、构造器以及泛型实参的访问，免去大量样板代码。
可扩展的 Converter SPI，内置基础类型、集合、Duration、InputStream 等转换器。
轻量 EventDispatcher，支持顺序（direct）与并行（parallel）两种执行模式。
类路径扫描、JAR 内省、Maven / 模块制品解析，支持从 JAR manifest 推断运行时版本。
自定义 URLStreamHandler 与 URL 工具；增强的文件、流、字符集工具以及文件监听服务。
委派式 Executor 包装器与自定义 ThreadFactory。
基于 SPI 的属性加载，配合注解驱动的元数据生成。
为 @ConfigurationProperty 生成元数据的 Annotation Processor。
面向 javax.lang.model 的组件，以及桥接 Java 编译器与注解处理工具 API 的辅助类。
面向 JUnit 5 的基类与工具。
modules: 核心工具：字符串、集合、反射、I/O、并发、事件、类型转换
Java 语言模型 API 的组件与工具
Java 编译器与 JDK 工具 API 辅助
@ConfigurationProperty 元数据的编译期处理器
基于 JUnit 5 的测试模型与工具

en.tagline: Microsphere's implementation of the Java EE specifications
en.summary: Implements the Java EE (pre-Jakarta) specifications the Microsphere way, offering a programming model consistent with the rest of the ecosystem for teams that need standardised enterprise APIs.
features: Provides implementation modules for the corresponding Java EE specifications.
Reuses the reflection, type conversion and event capabilities of Microsphere Java.
Forms a dual EE / Jakarta support track together with microsphere-jakarta.
modules: Aggregator module for the Java EE implementations

zh.tagline: Java EE 规范的 Microsphere 实现
zh.summary: 以 Microsphere 的方式实现 Java EE（Jakarta EE 前身）规范，为需要标准化企业 API 的场景提供与生态一致的编程模型。
features: 按 Java EE 规范提供对应实现模块。
复用 Microsphere Java 的反射、类型转换与事件能力。
与 microsphere-jakarta 形成 EE / Jakarta 双线支持。
modules: Java EE 规范实现聚合模块

en.tagline: Microsphere's implementation of the Jakarta EE specifications
en.summary: An implementation track targeting the Jakarta EE namespace (jakarta.*), for enterprise applications that have completed the migration away from Java EE.
features: Fully adapted to the jakarta.* package namespace.
Matches the Jakarta baseline adopted by Spring Framework 6 and later.
modules: Aggregator module for the Jakarta EE implementations

zh.tagline: Jakarta EE 规范的 Microsphere 实现
zh.summary: 面向 Jakarta EE 命名空间（jakarta.*）的实现分支，适配从 Java EE 迁移后的企业应用。
features: 全面适配 jakarta.* 包名。
匹配 Spring Framework 6+ 采用的 Jakarta 基线。
modules: Jakarta EE 实现聚合模块

en.tagline: One abstraction layer for runtime logging management
en.summary: Manage logging configuration across a JVM without touching application code or restarting services. It auto-loads the highest-priority Logging implementation via SPI and supports JUL, Log4j, Log4j2 and Logback coexisting in the same process.
features: Adjust log levels in production without restarting the service.
Write management code once; it works across every supported backend.
Expose and control logging configuration through JMX for operations teams.
JUnit 4 and JUnit Jupiter 5 extensions to verify behaviour across multiple log levels.
Load the highest-priority Logging implementation automatically via Java ServiceLoader.
Use several logging backends in one JVM with priority-based resolution.
modules: Core API: Logging interface, LoggingUtils, JMX support

zh.tagline: 跨日志框架的统一运行时管理抽象层
zh.summary: 在不改动应用代码、不重启服务的前提下，统一管理 JVM 中的日志配置。它通过 SPI 自动装载优先级最高的 Logging 实现，同时支持 JUL、Log4j、Log4j2、Logback 多后端共存。
features: 生产环境动态调整日志级别，无需重启服务。
管理代码只写一次，跨全部受支持后端生效。
通过 JMX 暴露并操控日志配置，方便运维介入。
提供 JUnit 4 与 JUnit Jupiter 5 扩展，可在多级别下验证日志行为。
通过 Java ServiceLoader 自动加载最高优先级的 Logging 实现。
同一 JVM 内可并行使用多个日志后端，按优先级解析。
modules: 核心 API：Logging 接口、LoggingUtils、JMX 支持
JUnit 4 / JUnit Jupiter 5 测试扩展

en.tagline: Eclipse MicroProfile support
en.summary: Provides Microsphere implementations of the MicroProfile specifications, targeting the standardised configuration, fault tolerance and metrics requirements of cloud-native microservices.
features: Covers MicroProfile configuration, fault tolerance, health checks and more.
Complements the multi-registry capabilities of Microsphere Spring Cloud.
modules: Aggregator module for the MicroProfile implementations

zh.tagline: Eclipse MicroProfile 支持
zh.summary: 为 MicroProfile 规范提供 Microsphere 实现，面向云原生微服务的配置、容错、指标等标准化需求。
features: 覆盖配置、容错、健康检查等 MicroProfile 能力。
与 Microsphere Spring Cloud 的多注册中心能力互补。

en.tagline: Cross-project testing infrastructure
en.summary: Provides a shared testing baseline and assertion utilities so every Microsphere sub-project follows the same testing conventions.
features: Centralised test base classes and helper assertions.

zh.tagline: 跨项目测试基础设施
zh.summary: 为 Microsphere 各子项目提供共享的测试基座与断言工具，保证测试风格在全生态内一致。
features: 集中提供测试基类与辅助断言。
modules: 测试基础设施聚合模块

en.tagline: Shared development tooling
en.summary: Collects the utilities repeatedly used across the ecosystem during day-to-day development and operations, shared by every sub-project.
features: A single home for utilities shared across projects.

zh.tagline: 通用研发工具集
zh.summary: 沉淀 Microsphere 生态在日常开发与运维中反复使用的工具类，供各子项目共享。
features: 集中收纳跨项目通用的辅助工具。

en.tagline: Production-grade extensions for the Spring Framework
en.summary: Solves real production pain points in a modular way: enhancing dependency injection, configuration management, web endpoint handling, events, caching and JDBC monitoring. It is a pure additive enhancement — a drop-in dependency for any existing Spring application.
features: Resolves the bean dependency graph and initialises independent singletons concurrently to cut startup time.
Intercepts property resolution and profile activation via EnvironmentListener and PropertyResolverListener.
@ResourcePropertySource adds wildcard patterns, ordering, inheritance and auto-refresh on change, plus @YamlPropertySource and @JsonPropertySource.
@EnableTTLCaching / @TTLCacheable add per-entry time-to-live to Spring Cache, including Redis.
Collects WebEndpointMapping metadata from Spring MVC, WebFlux and classic Servlet at startup for introspection and routing.
HandlerMethodInterceptor / HandlerMethodArgumentInterceptor provide AOP-style hooks around MVC and WebFlux controller invocations.
@EnableP6DataSource transparently wraps existing DataSource beans for SQL tracing.
@EnableGuice bridges Guice @Inject injection points into the Spring bean lifecycle.
EmbeddedTomcatContextLoader, @EnableEmbeddedDatabase, AbstractWebFluxTest and servlet/MVC test helpers.

zh.tagline: 面向生产环境的 Spring Framework 扩展库
zh.summary: 以模块化方式解决真实生产场景中的 Spring 痛点：增强依赖注入、配置管理、Web 端点处理、事件、缓存与 JDBC 监控。它是纯粹的增量增强，可作为 drop-in 依赖接入任何既有 Spring 应用。
features: 解析 Bean 依赖图，并发初始化互不依赖的单例，显著缩短启动时间。
通过 EnvironmentListener / PropertyResolverListener 拦截属性解析与 profile 激活事件。
@ResourcePropertySource 支持通配符资源、顺序控制、继承、变更自动刷新，并提供 @YamlPropertySource、@JsonPropertySource。
@EnableTTLCaching / @TTLCacheable 为 Spring Cache 增加条目级过期时间，支持 Redis。
启动时收集 Spring MVC、WebFlux 与经典 Servlet 的 WebEndpointMapping 元数据，供内省与路由使用。
HandlerMethodInterceptor / HandlerMethodArgumentInterceptor 提供围绕 MVC 与 WebFlux 控制器调用的 AOP 式钩子。
@EnableP6DataSource 透明包装既有 DataSource Bean，实现 SQL 追踪。
@EnableGuice 把 Guice @Inject 注入点桥接到 Spring Bean 生命周期。

en.tagline: Dynamic runtime configuration without restarts
en.summary: A production-ready extension library for Spring Cloud that targets common operational pain points in distributed systems — above all, applying runtime configuration changes without restarting the application.
features: Dynamically refreshes Feign client components (encoder, decoder, retryer, request interceptors) in response to EnvironmentChangeEvent — no restart required.
Registers a single service instance with several registries at once (Nacos, Eureka, Consul, Zookeeper) through one unified API.
Rich lifecycle events published via AOP — RegistrationPreRegisteredEvent, RegistrationRegisteredEvent, RegistrationPreDeregisteredEvent and RegistrationDeregisteredEvent.
Aggregates service instances from multiple discovery backends behind a single DiscoveryClient interface.
Weighted round-robin load balancing and Tomcat dynamic configuration support for improved resilience.
Built-in /service-registration and /service-deregistration endpoints for operational control at runtime.
The main branch targets Spring Cloud 2022.x – 2025.x; the 1.x branch covers Hoxton – 2021.0.x.
modules: Common utilities for service discovery, registration and fault tolerance
Parent POM with Spring Cloud version profiles

zh.tagline: 免重启的动态运行时配置能力
zh.summary: 面向 Spring Cloud 的生产就绪扩展库，重点解决分布式系统运维中的常见痛点——尤其是无需重启应用即可完成运行时配置变更。
features: 响应 EnvironmentChangeEvent 动态刷新 Feign 客户端的 encoder、decoder、retryer、请求拦截器等配置，无需重启。
通过统一 API 将同一服务实例同时注册到 Nacos、Eureka、Consul、Zookeeper 等多个注册中心。
经 AOP 发布注册生命周期事件，实现注册状态变更的细粒度可观测。
在单一 DiscoveryClient 接口后聚合多个服务发现后端的实例。
加权轮询负载均衡与 Tomcat 动态配置支持，提升韧性。
内置 /service-registration 与 /service-deregistration 端点，支持运行时运维控制。
main 分支兼容 Spring Cloud 2022.x – 2025.x，1.x 分支兼容 Hoxton – 2021.0.x。
modules: 服务发现、注册与容错的通用工具
OpenFeign 扩展，支持自动刷新
父 POM，含 Spring Cloud 版本 profile

en.tagline: Configuration governance, diagnostics and enhanced monitoring
en.summary: Adds production-ready capabilities to Spring Boot applications around configuration management, application diagnostics and enhanced monitoring: sensible out-of-the-box defaults, Actuator endpoints that expose far more runtime state, and cross-version compatibility from Spring Boot 2.x to 4.x.
features: Loads graceful shutdown, MVC filter toggles and other defaults from config/default/*.properties on the classpath, overridable per module.
A configurable import filter that merges multiple microsphere.autoconfigure.exclude sources without losing earlier exclusions.
Event-driven BindListener hooks notify your beans whenever a @ConfigurationProperties-bound value changes.
Four additional endpoints expose classpath artifact metadata, web endpoint mappings, configuration metadata and bound configuration properties.
A ThreadPoolTaskScheduler wrapper that records execution metrics via Micrometer — task latency and counts out of the box.
Detects duplicate JAR artifacts on the classpath at startup and surfaces a descriptive FailureAnalyzer message.
A dedicated compatibility shim keeps one codebase running on Spring Boot 2.x through 4.x without forking.
modules: Core: default properties, auto-configuration filter, bind listeners, diagnostics
Actuator extensions: custom endpoints, monitored scheduler, endpoint defaults
Compatibility shim for Spring Boot 2.x – 4.x (not published to Maven Central)
en.note: Unlike spring.autoconfigure.exclude, which replaces earlier values, microsphere.autoconfigure.exclude uses merge semantics: exclusions from multiple sources accumulate.

zh.tagline: 配置治理、应用诊断与增强监控
zh.summary: 围绕配置管理、应用诊断与增强监控，为 Spring Boot 应用补充生产就绪能力：既有开箱即用的默认值，也有把运行时状态暴露得更彻底的 Actuator 端点，还解决了 Spring Boot 2.x 到 4.x 的跨版本兼容问题。
features: 从 classpath 的 config/default/*.properties 加载优雅停机、MVC 过滤器开关等默认值，可按模块覆盖。
可配置的导入过滤器，合并多个 microsphere.autoconfigure.exclude 来源而不丢失先前排除项。
事件驱动的 BindListener，在 @ConfigurationProperties 绑定值变化时通知业务 Bean。
新增四个端点，暴露类路径制品元数据、Web 端点映射、配置元数据与已绑定配置属性。
ThreadPoolTaskScheduler 包装器，通过 Micrometer 记录任务延迟与执行次数。
启动时检测类路径上的重复 JAR 制品，并以描述性 FailureAnalyzer 消息呈现。
专用兼容 shim 模块让同一套代码同时跑在 Spring Boot 2.x 至 4.x 上，无需分叉维护。
modules: 核心：默认属性、自动配置过滤器、绑定监听器、诊断
Actuator 扩展：自定义端点、受监控调度器、端点默认值
Spring Boot 2.x – 4.x 兼容 shim（不发布至 Maven Central）
zh.note: 相比标准 spring.autoconfigure.exclude 的覆盖语义，microsphere.autoconfigure.exclude 采用合并语义，多个配置源的排除项会累加。

en.tagline: Discovery-driven dynamic routing for web endpoints
en.summary: Extends the Spring Cloud Gateway ecosystem with Microsphere-specific routing, discovery and refresh behaviour. A custom we:// route scheme exposes the web endpoints of discovered services behind a single gateway, so you never duplicate route definitions in every service.
features: Dedicated modules for Spring Cloud Gateway WebFlux and Gateway Server MVC.
Routes discovered web endpoints dynamically through a custom we:// scheme backed by Spring Cloud discovery.
Keeps routes current when gateway configuration, route definitions or service instances change.
metadata.web-endpoint.excludes filters by path, method, header, param, consumes and produces.
A shared BOM and commons module keep every gateway module consistent.
modules: Shared constants, annotations and configuration binding
Servlet-based integration for Spring Cloud Gateway Server MVC
en.note: Target services must publish Microsphere web endpoint metadata so the gateway can discover request mappings and rewrite incoming paths correctly.

zh.tagline: 基于服务发现的 Web 端点动态路由
zh.summary: 扩展 Spring Cloud Gateway 生态，提供 Microsphere 特有的路由、服务发现与刷新行为。通过自定义 we:// 路由协议，把已发现服务的 Web 端点统一暴露在单个网关之后，无需在每个服务里重复定义路由。
features: 分别为 Spring Cloud Gateway WebFlux 与 Gateway Server MVC 提供独立模块。
通过自定义 we:// 路由协议，基于 Spring Cloud 服务发现动态路由已发现的 Web 端点。
当网关配置、路由定义或服务实例发生变化时自动保持路由最新。
通过 metadata.web-endpoint.excludes 按路径、方法、请求头、参数、consumes、produces 过滤。
统一 BOM 与公共模块
提供 BOM 与共享 commons 模块，保证各模块一致接入。
modules: 共享常量、注解与配置绑定
Servlet 网关集成（Spring Cloud Gateway Server MVC）
zh.note: 目标服务必须发布 Microsphere Web 端点元数据，网关才能发现请求映射并正确重写入站路径。

en.tagline: Apache Dubbo integration
en.summary: A Microsphere integration project for the Apache Dubbo RPC framework, bringing the ecosystem's interception, observability and resilience capabilities into Dubbo call chains.
features: Combines with Observability, Sentinel and other capabilities.
modules: Aggregator module for the Dubbo integration

zh.tagline: Apache Dubbo 集成
zh.summary: 面向 Apache Dubbo RPC 框架的 Microsphere 集成项目，把生态中的拦截、可观测与容错能力带到 Dubbo 服务调用链路。
features: 提供与 Apache Dubbo 的集成能力。
可与 Observability、Sentinel 等能力组合。

en.tagline: An enhanced Spring Data Redis integration framework
en.summary: Adds enterprise-grade capabilities on top of Spring Data Redis: non-intrusive command interception, deep Spring integration, comprehensive event publishing and metrics collection, and Redis replication support backed by Kafka.
features: Monitor and intercept Redis commands without modifying application code.
Seamless integration with Spring dependency injection and auto-configuration.
Comprehensive event publishing and metrics collection.
Advanced replication features integrated with Kafka.
Multiple Maven modules with clean separation of concerns.
A dedicated generator module produces Redis metadata.
modules: Foundational components and utilities for Redis operations

zh.tagline: 增强版 Spring Data Redis 集成框架
zh.summary: 在 Spring Data Redis 之上提供企业级增强能力：非侵入式的 Redis 命令拦截、深度 Spring 集成、全面的事件发布与指标采集，以及基于 Kafka 的 Redis 复制支持。
features: 无需修改应用代码即可监控与拦截 Redis 命令。
与 Spring 依赖注入和自动配置无缝衔接。
全面的事件发布与指标采集能力。
高级复制特性，并与 Kafka 集成。
多 Maven 模块清晰分离关注点。
generator 模块负责 Redis 元数据生成。
modules: Redis 操作的基础组件与工具

en.tagline: SQL interception for the Druid connection pool
en.summary: Enhances Alibaba Druid, a high-performance JDBC connection pool, with fine-grained SQL statement interception and logging. It serves as the interception foundation for Sentinel, Resilience4j, Observability and other projects.
features: Intercepts SQL statements at execution time for downstream extensions.
Covers Spring Framework, Spring Boot auto-configuration and Spring Cloud discovery.
Provides the interception entry point for Sentinel, Resilience4j and Observability.
modules: Foundation classes and filters for Druid integration
Spring Cloud features and service discovery integration

zh.tagline: 为 Druid 连接池注入 SQL 拦截能力
zh.summary: 增强 Alibaba Druid 高性能 JDBC 连接池，提供细粒度的 SQL 语句拦截与日志能力，并作为 Sentinel、Resilience4j、Observability 等项目的底层扩展支撑。
features: 在执行阶段拦截 SQL 语句，供上下游项目扩展。
细粒度记录 SQL 执行情况。
覆盖 Spring Framework、Spring Boot 自动配置、Spring Cloud 服务发现。
为 Sentinel、Resilience4j、Observability 提供拦截入口。
modules: Druid 集成的基础类与过滤器
Spring Boot 自动配置与属性
Spring Cloud 特性与服务发现集成
